title: The Helpful Donkey | Fun Kids Song & Nursery Rhymes | BuBu TV - English
description:
A happy donkey carries a big bundle, but it's too heavy! Friends help each other with light little bags.
This song teaches kids that helping one another makes every job easy and fun.
Sing along and count the hee haws together!

Hee haw, I help, hee haw
you help too, hee haw
hee haw, hee haw, hee haw
helping friends, we all say so!

Oh dear, the bundle is so heavy
the donkey starts to wobble
wibble, wobble, wibble, wobble
oh no, the bundle's going to fall!

Little sis and big bro each take a bag
small bags, light as a feather
light, light, light
now the donkey feels much better!

Amma waves, "Come home, come home!"
the donkey trots down the lane
trot, trot, trot, trot
thank you, friends, see you again!
